plain.reason: Brock Purdy projects for 29.4 pass attempts, just under his line, so the under 30.5 is the bet. His blended rate is 29.2 a game (5 games this season, 11 last season); WSH being a pass funnel (+1.1% here) pushes it up to the projection. We make the under 51.5%; at -106 it needs 51.5%, and DraftKings' no-vig price says 48.5%, so the edge is the projection, at half weight while Pass Att props are untested.
plain.risk: The cushion over break-even is thin (51.5% against 51.5%).

plain.reason: Jayden Daniels projects for 50.1 rushing yards, comfortably over his line, so the over 39.5 is the side. Would be a +1.31 Kelly bet with its doubt cleared (the over 57% against DraftKings' no-vig 49%); model 50.1 vs the book's 46.5 rushing yards. Not bet on this side: his team is changing quarterbacks, the side a role change's known error could be making. The question: how much of the work is his now, and has the market already priced it?
plain.risk: A big Kelly on the model's own number isn't value by itself: such numbers have won at about the book's rate, and a role change is news the market prices faster than the model reads it.
